cases.contract: Three active rows are snapshotted, soft-deleted, linked to undo and compensated in order.
Referenced rows are returned in skippedRowIds while every deletable row commits atomically.
An all-blocked request succeeds without snapshots, undo anchors, delete writes or compensation.
Any missing or already-deleted requested row rejects the whole first execution before writes.
Snapshot failure rolls back every main-transaction effect.
Undo-anchor failure rolls back soft delete and snapshots.
An identical idempotency-key/hash replay returns the stored terminal decision without repeating effects.
A failed ordered compensation remains durable, observable and resumable.
Concurrent same-panel deletes are serialized by tenant-panel mutation ownership.
An in-flight same-panel update excludes delete until the owner releases the gate.
